action: If safety or building alarms in your organisation rely on email alone, add a second channel such as a text message, phone call or on-site alarm, and test that alerts still arrive when email is down.
date_note: Article date; the poisoning happened during the Nov 12-14 outage
exec: A safety-critical alert that relied on email alone failed during a cloud outage, with physical harm as the result.
plain: A news report says the earlier Microsoft 365 outage stopped a chlorine warning email from reaching a German hotel, and 15 guests were poisoned. The outage itself was not caused by a cyberattack.
summary: Security Affairs reports that the Microsoft 365 outage stopped a chlorine warning email from arriving at a German hotel and 15 guests were poisoned. This is a downstream physical consequence of the outage. Cyber cause: ruled out for the outage itself.
title: Microsoft outage blocked a chlorine alert email; 15 hotel guests poisoned in Germany
